scope: Manual source-first inventory after complete reading of all20 bodies, before a cohort-specific current-owner comparison. Earlier TDLU fields and project evidence are known; no blind or independent review claimed. Scientific requirements, fictional premises and output-production contracts remain separate.

requirements.requirement: The magnified normal cutaway shows one acinus, not a whole lobule or breast; no second basement-membrane envelope is added around its stroma.
Distinguish central lumen, luminal epithelium, living nucleated myoepithelial cells, extracellular basement membrane and surrounding stroma in that order.
A cell plasma membrane, a living myoepithelial cell and the acellular basement membrane are different objects; the basement membrane has no nuclei or cytoplasm.
Colours, pointer targets and counts are schematic normal anatomy, not scale, diagnosis, a marker test, lineage, milk flow, metastasis or treatment evidence.
The fictional denominator is evaluated eligible invasive tumour-cell nuclei: field A90positive/900total and B50/100, not all tissue cells or tissue area.
For those fictional counts, A10%, B50%, pooled140/1000=14%, equal-field-weight mean30% and selected hotspotB50% are distinct calculations.
The larger field contributes90% and the smaller10% of the pooled nuclear denominator; this is count aggregation rather than tissue-area weighting or equal field weights.
The toy estimators do not reproduce an IKWG weighted-global protocol or establish doubling time, cell killing or a TNBC clinical cutoff.

Count denominators and positive fractions are different scales: a larger counted field can contribute more nuclei yet have a lower positive percentage. Illustration bars are not literal nuclear censuses.

Both fictional nodal cases are surgery-first ipsilateral levelI/II axillary examples with three involved nodes and no other regional finding identified; no total examined denominator or unsampled-negative result is invented.
Three known0.8mm deposits, with micrometastases only, illustrate pN1mi in the stated context rather than an overall stage.
One known4mm deposit among three involved axillary nodes illustrates pN1a in that context; the other two deposit sizes remain unspecified.

Known deposit diameters, not node-outline diameters, carry the comparison. Illustrative node sizes and missing deposit dimensions are not measured facts; no ITC-only generalisation or overall stage is inferred.
Pretreatment biopsy supplies clinical evidence, while surgery-first tissue and post-neoadjuvant clinical/surgical assessments retain the distinct c,p,yc,yp contexts.
A later addendum to an old biopsy does not convert that specimen collection context into yp; issue time and collection/treatment time are different.
Needle sampling does not automatically confer a pathological category. Do not mix pretreatment and residual categories, invent pM0 or infer a treatment schedule from the diagram.
Tubule formation, nuclear appearance and mitotic assessment are separate microscopic features; drawn darkness or varied nuclei do not independently assign scores.
The already assigned fictional report scores2+3+3 sum to8, grade3. The cartoon glyphs do not establish those scores.
Mitotic counting retains method and field-area conditions; grade and stage are different assessments. Conceptual mitosis is not a diagnostic histology reproduction.
Repair cause, historical genomic scars and current functional evidence are different layers, not interchangeable measurements.

A selected possible restoration mechanism during tumour evolution can coexist in the stipulated two-time-point example with retained old scar marks and changed current RAD51 evidence; no universal frequency or restoration is asserted.
Scores and RAD51 assays retain method and sampling time; those observations establish neither inheritance nor guaranteed drug response.

Two newly detected metastases without prior distant disease, two persistent lesions after a previously larger burden, and two growing sites among many stable sites describe different histories despite the repeated numbertwo.
The third fictional history has more than two total sites. Many-site icons are symbolic, and a count of growing sites is not the total disease count.

Timeline arrows mean later observation rather than anatomical spread; detected visible burden is not every cancer cell. No universal threshold, eligibility, cure or added local-treatment benefit follows.
In100fully followed fictional participants,20recur and five of those have brain involvement:5/20=25% among recurrences versus5/100=5% among enrolled people.

The example assumes complete two-year follow-up from enrolment, no losses and one dot per patient. Its raw fractions are not competing-risk estimates, personal forecasts, site rankings or screening advice.
HER2 membrane completeness, intensity and stained-cell extent are separate observations; illustrative glyphs are not a counted diagnostic field.

Under the explicitly dated September2026 CAP template,0means no detected membrane stain,0+faint incomplete staining in10%or fewer and1+faint incomplete staining in more than10%. No zero-receptor proof follows.

The representative2+pattern is weak/moderate complete membrane staining; the3+pattern is complete intense staining in more than10% with the homogeneous contiguous population qualifier. These representative scenes do not replace the complete algorithm.
An IHC score and integrated HER2 status/workup are different claims. No universal drug eligibility or expression-to-benefit inference follows from these rows.
The fictional stain belongs to normal myoepithelial cells around a benign duct in one region and labelled malignant cells in another; attribute the signal to the actual stained population.
SOX10 alone does not establish breast origin, an RNA subtype/BL1 assignment, ancestry, dependence or treatment benefit. The labelled patterns are invented examples, not a scoring standard.
ER/PR/HER2 receptor category, an RNA research profile and the cells contributing RNA answer separate questions; no causal arrow to clinical outcome is established.

TNBCtype-4 has four refined labels BL1,BL2,M,LAR. The qualitative four-column/five-row illustration is not empirical expression data, cell morphology, lineage, a best/worst ranking or an added IM/MSL/fifth group.
A bulk sample can contain RNA from cancer, immune and stromal populations. The three drawn categories and colours are not measured proportions or a pure-tumour conversion.
Receptor testing is not replaced by RNA profiling, and research-profile labels or tissue mixture do not on their own select treatment or predict benefit.
The selected continuous nodal deposit crosses the capsule into nearby soft tissue; a disconnected deposit is not drawn as proof of that direct extension.
A specimen cut/inked margin and a vessel lumen are separate boundaries. Direct capsule crossing, a cut edge and vascular invasion are different observations.
The conceptual ENE drawing supplies no preferred extent-measurement axis, distant-spread conclusion or complete staging category.

The conceptual lumpectomy scene removes a variable local piece while retaining gland; the explicitly nipple-sparing mastectomy scene designates gland removal while retaining the outer skin/nipple outline.
These are conceptual tissue maps, not cut instructions, measured excision percentages, final postoperative shape, reconstructive results or guaranteed complete tissue clearance.
The depicted gland excision does not automatically determine nodal surgery, radiotherapy or systemic treatment and does not rank operations.
Mapped nodesA/B and a separately clipped, unmapped nodeC illustrate distinct identities; a marker does not itself establish current cancer.
Mapped and clipped identity can overlap in one node. A broader axillary packet is not every regional node and does not guarantee retrieval of a particular clipped node.

Selected halos, clips and node counts are arbitrary sampling examples, not spread chronology, fixed yield, a pathological result, universal accuracy or an operation recommendation; the clipped-node context is the described post-neoadjuvant study.

Their specific assertions remain checked or named in the custody/visual packet, with no experimental or approval credit.
